description: Look up any UK postcode and get latitude/longitude, local council, county, ward, parish, parliamentary constituency, region and country, from official ONS data. Use when you need to place a UK address on a map, work out which council or MP covers it, or check a postcode is real. Spaces optional. Errors: 400 invalid format, 404 postcode not found. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402).
name: uk_postcode_lookup
title: UK postcode lookup
